prompt: A town with no right angles anywhere.

card.name: The Curving Town

site.text: A town on level ground where streets, walls and plots curve and flow; no right angles anywhere in the layout.

style.text: Organic and flowing: rounded, curved walls, circular and oval footprints, domed or swooping roofs, winding lanes, no square corners.

purpose.text: A general-purpose town to live in, with homes, a market and a few workplaces.

card.interpretation: You asked for a town with no right angles. I took that as the whole layout and every building: curving lanes, round and oval footprints, and domed or swooping roofs. I made it a medium general-purpose home town on flat ground, since you gave no other purpose or setting.

contradictions.issue: Minecraft is built on a block grid, so true non-right angles are impossible.
contradictions.resolution: Use diagonals, stepped arcs and circles to approximate curves, avoiding visible square corners in plans and rooflines.

assumptions: Medium size, as none was given.
Purpose is a general home town, since none was stated.
Style is custom organic and curved, with no template.

program.notes: Round or oval hall with a domed roof, at the heart of curving lanes.
Circular or oval plans with conical or domed roofs, set at varied angles.
Kidney-shaped or crescent plans hugging the lanes.
Crescent-shaped stalls around a round plaza.
Circular common room with a curved bar.
Oval forge with a rounded chimney.
Oval barn with a barrel-vaulted roof.
